notes.title: 3 Days Until Release of Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping!
notes.notes:
Only 72 hours to go! 

Don't forget to tell a friend, enemy, sidekick, and ex-lover about the next case, waddling it's way to release on 22nd May!

We're really exicted for you to finally play The Ghost of Glamping, and while it's still a few days away, we've created a short video to help you prepare mentally for the presence of your sidekick:

[previewyoutube=aKdqoaLSg_k;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45340541/6ac6905e54a8c5559b196a346df9a8c40eb10a90.jpg
